# Invitations, Membership, Downgrade, Activity & Contract Checklist: Sharing & Invitations

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements behind the B9 surface frozen for the C9 client: invitation lifecycle, membership changes, plan downgrade, activity, security and privacy, and the API contract.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [sharing.yaml](../../../docs/openapi/paths/sharing.yaml) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer. The owner delegated the review to the agent running the design phases, which evaluated each item and fixed the spec where an item failed (resolution log below), as for specs 011–015.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Invitation lifecycle

- [x] CHK001 Are every invitation state and every transition (including the wallet-deletion close) enumerated, with what each transition does to `deleted_at`, the address and the token? [Completeness, Spec §3, FR-009]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behaviour of a create replayed with a different version, and of a positive version for an unknown id, specified? [Clarity, Spec FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Is "same address" defined for the supersede rule (normalised lookup value, not the typed string)? [Clarity, Spec FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is expiry specified both as a stored transition (sweep cadence) and as an instant checked at acceptance, so the sweep's lag cannot widen access? [Consistency, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK005 Is the fate of pending invitations defined for wallet deletion, wallet archive and ownership transfer? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is what happens when the invitation mail cannot be delivered specified (retries, invitation state, owner recourse)? [Exception Flow, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Is the share link's single disclosure, and the replay's lack of it, stated with the owner's recourse? [Clarity, Spec US2 #3, Clarifications]

## Token operations

- [x] CHK008 Is the set of token states answered as not found enumerated, and is it identical across preview, accept and decline? [Consistency, Spec FR-010/011/013]
- [x] CHK009 Is the address-match rule for email invitations defined against the keyed lookup value, and its failure indistinguishable from a dead token? [Clarity, Spec FR-011, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK010 Are the idempotency outcomes of accept (already member; same person retrying) and decline (same person repeating) each specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-012/013]
- [x] CHK011 Is preview's answer for a token the caller already accepted defined? [Edge Case, Spec FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Is the verification-gate position of each token operation and of leave explicitly stated and reconciled with the security baseline? [Consistency, Spec FR-014/028, Clarifications]

## Membership changes

- [x] CHK013 Is the replay behaviour of a role change to the role already held specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-015]
- [x] CHK014 Is removal of a person whose latest membership is already a tombstone (left, removed, wallet deleted) specified, and distinguished from "never a member"? [Clarity, Spec FR-016]
- [x] CHK015 Are the owner's own role change, own removal and own leave each covered with a defined refusal? [Coverage, Spec FR-015/017, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is the sync signal for a removed or departed member defined by reference to ADR-0008 rule 15 and ADR-0017 rule 4 rather than a new mechanism? [Traceability, Spec FR-018]
- [x] CHK017 Are stamping order and lock order for multi-person membership writes stated? [Completeness, Spec FR-018, data-model]
- [x] CHK018 Is exactly one audit event per membership act specified, including the plan demotion's actor? [Completeness, Spec FR-019]
- [x] CHK019 Is what happens to every kind of record a departing member authored (transactions, rules, category references, budgets) specified? [Coverage, Spec FR-020, Edge Cases]

## Entitlements and downgrade

- [x] CHK020 Is the quota arithmetic stated precisely for both create and accept, including the owner, pending invitations, expired-but-unswept invitations and null (unlimited)? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Is the ranking that decides who is "beyond the quota" defined deterministically? [Clarity, Spec FR-021]
- [x] CHK022 Are the downgrade triggers enumerated (lapse to expired or revoked; grace excluded; ownership transfer) and the enforcement declared idempotent and never promoting? [Completeness, Spec FR-021, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK023 Is re-promotion after downgrade both prevented (S-03 capability) and documented as manual? [Consistency, Spec FR-015, US7 #3]
- [x] CHK024 Are owner actions that must never be plan-gated (revoke, remove, lower to viewer) explicitly listed? [Coverage, Spec §6, US3 #3]
- [x] CHK025 Does the refusal shape let the client tell "no sharing" from "wallet full" without a new error code? [Clarity, Spec §5]

## Activity

- [x] CHK026 Is the set of writes that produce an activity entry, and the ones that deliberately do not, enumerated? [Completeness, Spec FR-023]
- [x] CHK027 Is how Activity Entry differs from the audit log stated (audience, content, retention, sync)? [Clarity, Clarifications, research R-12]
- [x] CHK028 Is the display-name rule for actors who are no longer members specified? [Privacy, Spec FR-024]

## Security, privacy and abuse

- [x] CHK029 Is the uniform-answer requirement stated as observable behaviour (same status and body, no address lookup on the request path) rather than an untestable "timing class"? [Measurability, Spec FR-005]
- [x] CHK030 Are rate limits quantified per actor and per address, with which ones answer 429 and which are silent, and whether replays count? [Clarity, Spec FR-026]
- [x] CHK031 Is who can read an invited address, for how long, and how it is protected at rest specified? [Completeness, Clarifications, Spec §3]
- [x] CHK032 Is the absence of tokens and addresses from logs, audit and activity stated as a measurable outcome? [Measurability, Spec SC-009]

## API contract

- [x] CHK033 Is every operation's success status, body and documented error set listed in the spec and matched by the path file? [Consistency, Spec §5, sharing.yaml]
- [x] CHK034 Are the brief's endpoint shapes reconciled with the conventions (PUT create, token in body) with the reason recorded? [Traceability, Spec reconcile table]
- [x] CHK035 Are the additive changes outside the path file (`Problem.feature`, `invitation` feed rows, `info.version`) recorded? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK036 Are performance and sizing targets quantified for the new reads and writes? [Measurability, Spec SC-008, Clarifications]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.

### Resolution log

| Item | Gap found | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| CHK002 | Replay with another version and positive version for an unknown id were only in the path file | FR-002 states both |
| CHK006 | No requirement for an undeliverable mail | Edge Cases "Mail failure": 3 attempts, id-only log, invitation stays, owner revokes and resends |
| CHK011 | Preview of an already-accepted token was undefined | FR-010: not found; retries go through accept |
| CHK013 | Role change to the current role had no defined answer | FR-015: a replay, nothing changed |
| CHK014 | Removal of someone who already left was undefined | FR-016: returns the latest tombstone; never-member is not found |
| CHK020 | FR-022 pointed at "FR edge rule", an undefined reference | FR-022 now names Edge Cases "Quota arithmetic" |
| CHK029 | "timing class" was not testable | FR-005: same status and body, no address lookup on the request path; the job alone decides the mail |
| CHK030 | Whether replays consume the create budget was unstated | FR-026: only applied creates count |
| — | Re-joining after removal was implicit | Edge Cases: a new membership record |
